top_theories: Sustainability Science - Ecosystem Stewardship and Restoration | Sustainability Science - Adaptive and Polycentric Governance | Sustainability Science - Environmental Peacebuilding
why_effective: Ecosystem Stewardship and Restoration: Restoration creates visible ecological gains and shared protection goals. || Adaptive and Polycentric Governance: Polycentric arrangements allow learning and adaptation across levels. || Environmental Peacebuilding: Ecological improvement and cooperation can reinforce one another.
conditions: Ecosystem Stewardship and Restoration: Best when pollution or ecological degradation weakens basin outcomes. || Adaptive and Polycentric Governance: Best when governance spans multiple sectors, scales, and stakeholders. || Environmental Peacebuilding: Best where degradation and political tension overlap but shared dependence remains.
effects: Ecosystem Stewardship and Restoration: Improves water quality, ecosystem services, and legitimacy of cooperation. || Adaptive and Polycentric Governance: Improves adaptability, coordination, and resilience. || Environmental Peacebuilding: Reduces conflict incentives and strengthens cooperation norms.
